metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Runtime Engine (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Dispatch • Measures • Paradox • Consent • RTT • Collapse
metadata.description: Defines the canonical runtime loop and execution rules for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Runtime MUST evaluate measures, enforce consent, handle paradox, obey RTT mapping, and guarantee collapse.

rules: Projections (dashboard, overlay, UI) MUST NOT override authoritative state.
Session MUST load substrate_class before dispatch.
Every gate MUST cite a measure ID.
Nominal regime requires measure.c1, c2, c3 >= 0.80 and paradox_density = 0.
Harmonic regime requires typed paradox and lattice_stability >= 0.60.
Resolution regime requires c1, c2, c3 >= 0.80.
Paradox density MUST be present for RTT7–RTT9.
If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
Consent conflicts MUST be logged as paradox.consent_conflict.
Operator MUST match current RTT node.
Continuity (measure.c3) MUST NOT decrease across transitions.
Session log MUST reflect authoritative state.
Paradox events MUST be recorded with typed paradox ID.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
Runtime MUST NOT reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.

non_claims: Runtime does not revise RTT v0.9.
Runtime does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Runtime does not replace the human FFT book.
